title: PodcastsView
description: Create AggregatorApp/Podcasts/PodcastsView.swift mirroring the ThreadsView/TodayView pattern. Declare private enum LoadPhase { case loading, loaded, error(Error) }. Use @Environment(CredentialsStore.self), @State episodes array, nextCursor, phase, isFetchingNextPage, and LoadOnceGate. body: NavigationStack > Group switching on phase — .loading shows ProgressView; .error shows message + Retry button; .loaded shows not-configured ContentUnavailableView when !credentialsStore.isConfigured, empty ContentUnavailableView("No episodes", systemImage: "headphones") when empty, else GlassEffectContainer > List > ForEach with NavigationLink to PodcastPlayerView passing credentialsStore explicitly. Last-row .onAppear triggers loadNextPage. .refreshable calls loadFirstPage(showSpinner: false). .task loads first page via loadGate.
acceptance_criteria: Loading, loaded, error, not-configured, and empty states all render correctly
NavigationLink pushes PodcastPlayerView with credentialsStore passed explicitly
Scrolling to the last row triggers loadNextPage exactly once (isFetchingNextPage guard)
Pull-to-refresh calls loadFirstPage without spinner flash
loadNextPage silently fails on network error without changing phase
